social-media-manager.title: Social Media Manager
body:
We are looking for a talented Social media manager to administer the social media accounts of our clients. You will be responsible for creating original text and video content, managing posts and responding to followers. You will manage our company image in a cohesive way to achieve our marketing goals.

As a Social media manager, we expect you to be up-to-date with the latest digital technologies and social media trends. You should have excellent communication skills and be able to administer campaigns for our clients with utmost creativity.

As a Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for creating and implementing the social media strategy for our clients, managing and growing their social media presence, and engaging with their audiences. You will work closely with the creative and account teams to develop and execute social media campaigns that align with clients' overall marketing goals.
Perform research on current benchmark trends and audience preferences
Develop and implement social media strategies for clients to increase brand awareness and engagement
Create and manage content calendar and plan, design, and execute campaigns across all social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.)
Monitor and analyze social media metrics to measure the success of campaigns and make adjustments as needed
Collaborate with the creative and account teams to develop content that aligns with clients' overall marketing goals
Stay up-to-date with the latest social media trends and best practices to ensure campaigns are effective and innovative
Build and maintain relationships with clients, manage expectations and provide regular reporting on campaign performance
Manage and lead a team of social media executives and interns
Continuously seek out opportunities to improve and optimize social media processes and strategies
Design and implement social media strategy to align with business goals
Set specific objectives and report on ROI
Monitor SEO and web traffic metrics
Communicate with followers, respond to queries in a timely manner and monitor customer reviews
Oversee social media accounts’ design (e.g. Facebook timeline cover, profile pictures and blog layout)
Suggest and implement new features to develop brand awareness, like promotions and competitions
Stay up-to-date with current technologies and trends in social media, design tools and applications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications or related field
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in social media management, preferably in an agency environment
Strong understanding of social media platforms and analytics tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong leadership skills and experience managing a team
Strong analytical skills and ability to measure the success of campaigns
Strong ability to create and execute creative social media campaigns
Proficient in graphic design, video editing and other creative tools is a plus
This is a full-time position with competitive salary and benefits.

At Mould Innovation, we value creativity, innovation, and teamwork, and we offer a fun and energetic work environment where you can learn, grow, and make a real impact. If you're passionate about social media and eager to join a dynamic team, we want to hear from you. Apply now!

graphic-design-intern.title: Graphic Design Intern
body:
We are looking for a highly motivated and creative Graphic Design Intern to join our team. As a Graphic Design Intern, you will work closely with our team of experienced designers to create visually stunning designs for a wide range of projects, including branding, print materials, digital media, and more. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about design and eager to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced agency environment.

We value creativity and innovation, and we offer a fun and energetic work environment where you can learn, grow, and make a real impact. If you're passionate about design and eager to join a dynamic team, we want to hear from you. Apply now!
Assist in the creation of visual design concepts and layouts for various projects
Work with the design team to develop and execute creative ideas
Assist in the production of print materials, such as brochures, posters, and packaging
Create graphics and layouts for digital media, such as social media posts, websites, and email campaigns
Collaborate with other teams, such as marketing and web development, to ensure that designs align with overall brand strategy
Help maintain design assets and project files
Continuously improve design skills and knowledge
Pursuing a degree in graphic design, visual communication, or a related field
Strong understanding of design principles and typography
Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
Understanding of digital media and web design is a plus
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week
This is a part-time unpaid intern position with the possibility of conversion to a full-time position based on performance.

digital-marketing-intern.title: Digital Marketing Intern
body:
We are looking for an enthusiastic marketing intern to join our marketing department and provide creative ideas to help achieve our goals. You will have administrative duties in developing and implementing marketing strategies.

As a marketing intern, you will collaborate with our marketing and advertising team in all stages of marketing campaigns. Your insightful contribution will help develop, expand and maintain our marketing channels.

This internship will help you acquire marketing skills and provide you with knowledge of various marketing strategies. Ultimately, you will gain broad experience in marketing and should be prepared to enter any fast paced work environment.
Assist in the development and implementation of digital marketing campaigns across various channels such as paid advertising, email marketing, content marketing, and more
Help to create and execute marketing plans and campaigns across various digital platforms such as Google, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn
Monitor and analyze campaign performance, and make recommendations for optimization
Collaborate with other teams such as creative and account management to develop campaign assets and ensure alignment with overall marketing goals
Stay up-to-date with the latest digital marketing trends and best practices
Continuously seek out opportunities to improve and optimize digital marketing processes and strategies
Manage and update company database and customer relationship management systems (CRM)
Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications or related field
Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and platforms
Strong analytical skills and ability to measure the success of campaigns
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
Strong ability to create and execute creative digital marketing campaigns
Available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week
This is a part-time unpaid intern position with the possibility of conversion to a full-time position based on performance.

senior-graphic-designer.title: Senior Graphic Designer
body:
We are looking for a Graphic Designer to create engaging and on-brand graphics for a variety of media.
You will be expected to spearhead the entire process of defining requirements, visualizing and creating graphics including illustrations, logos, layouts and photos - and create brand guidelines.

You’ll be the one to shape the visual aspects of websites, books, magazines, product packaging, exhibitions and more.

Your graphics should capture the attention of those who see them and communicate the right message. For this, you need to have a creative flair and a strong ability to translate requirements into design. If you can communicate well and work methodically as part of a team, we’d like to e-meet you.

The goal is to inspire and attract the target audience for our clients.
Lead the creation of visual design concepts and layouts for various projects
Work with the design team to develop and execute creative ideas
Produce print materials, such as brochures, posters, and packaging
Design graphics and layouts for digital media, such as social media posts, websites, and email campaigns
Collaborate with other teams, such as marketing and web development, to ensure that designs align with overall brand strategy
Mentor and guide junior designers and intern
Help maintain design assets and project files
Continuously improve design skills and knowledge
Study design briefs and determine requirements
Schedule projects and define budget constraints
Prepare rough drafts and present ideas
Develop illustrations, logos and other designs using software or by hand
Use the appropriate colors and layouts for each graphic
Work with copywriters and creative director to produce final design
Ensure final graphics and layouts are visually appealing and on-brand
Bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual communication, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years of experience in graphic design, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role
Strong understanding of design principles and typography
Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
Understanding of digital media and web design is a plus
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Strong leadership skills, with experience mentoring and guiding junior designers
Strong ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
This is a full-time position with competitive salary and benefits.
